title: zega view spec (APS 21)
description: One graph component, bound to one ZQL result: which component, the result field each data role reads, and the surface parameters and display options. Checked against the component's contract and the actual result before anything renders.

version.description: The contract version the spec was written for, e.g. "1" or "1.0.0". Its major must equal the component's.

binding.description: Role name -> a path into the ZQL result, e.g. {"path": "points[].at"}. `a.b` reads a field; `a[]` maps over a list; a leading `[]` maps over a result that is a list.

surface.description: Surface parameters, checked against the contract's `surface` descriptors. Omitted ones take their defaults.

options.description: Display options, checked against the contract's `options` descriptors. Omitted ones take their defaults.

fieldPath.description: A result path such as `name`, `points[].at` or `[].speed`.
